h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Sonipat

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Sonipat

c: Sonipat lies right on Delhi's northern edge, with private university campuses, industrial estates and new residential townships along the highway. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Sonipat for all three, and for schools and municipal parks in the city. We build every machine at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,150 km away, and dispatch it to Haryana by road.

University buyers often want an outdoor fitness zone near hostels or the sports ground, open to students at any hour. Township developers want a gym beside the clubhouse or the central park. Either way, we send a layout drawing showing each station and the clear space it needs, and our installation team or a dealer in north India puts it in once you approve.

items.q: Which outdoor gym frames suit groups of college students?
items.a: Multi gym frames and the Cross Fit frame let several students train at once. Add a few single stations such as a leg press or ab trainer to spread the crowd.

items.q: Can you supply industrial units in Sonipat?
items.a: Yes. Factories and offices add an open gym for staff near the canteen or entrance. Share the space and expected number of users, and we will suggest a layout.

items.q: Is a rubber floor needed under the machines?
items.a: It is not always required, but it helps under frames where people hang or jump, such as pull-up bars. We supply rubber flooring along with the equipment.
